'''Jerry Paul Gollub''' (September 9, 1944 – June 8, 2019) was an American [[physicist]].

== Life and career ==
Gollub was born in [[St. Louis, Missouri]]. He attended [[Oberlin College]], earning his [[Bachelor of Arts|AB degree]] in 1966. He also attended [[Harvard University]], earning his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]] in 1971.<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url= https://physicstoday.aip.org/obituaries/jerry-gollub|title=Jerry Gollub|work=[[Physics Today]]|date=July 22, 2019|access-date=July 10, 2026}}</ref>

Gollub served as a professor in the department of [[physics]] at [[Haverford College]] from 1971 to 2012. During his years as a professor, in 1979, he was named the John and Barbara Bush Professor of Physics,<ref name="a" /> In 1983, he was named a [[Fellow of the American Physical Society|fellow]] of the [[American Physical Society]], "for his imaginative research on [[Rayleigh–Bénard convection]] which has contributed significantly to the understanding of the transition to turbulence",<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/funding-recognition/aps-fellowship?q=jerry%20gollub&af=true|title=APS Fellow Archive|work=[[American Physical Society]]|access-date=July 10, 2026}}</ref> and was elected as a member of the [[National Academy of Sciences]] in 1993.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nasonline.org/directory-entry/jerry-p-gollub-fmjwgj/|title=Jerry P. Gollub|work=[[National Academy of Sciences]]|access-date=July 10, 2026}}</ref>

== Personal life and death ==
Gollub was married to Diane Nissen. Their marriage lasted until Gollub's death in 2019.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.haverford.edu/college-communications/news/jerry-gollub-1944-2019|title=Jerry Gollub 1944–2019|work=[[Haverford College]]|access-date=July 10, 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190819211047/https://www.haverford.edu/college-communications/news/jerry-gollub-1944-2019|archive-date=August 19, 2019|url-status=live|via=[[Wayback Machine]]}}</ref>

Gollub died in [[Haverford, Pennsylvania]] on June 8, 2019, at the age of 74.<ref name="a" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://aip.brightspotcdn.com/PTO.v72.i11.68_1.online.pdf|title=Jerry Paul Gollub|work=AIP|access-date=July 10, 2026}}</ref>
